correctness.rationale: Smoothness follows from F_X=X^s, F_Y=eta Y^s+Z^s, F_Z=Y^s. Every k-point satisfies eta*Y^(s+1) in F_s, forcing Y=X=0, so projective stabilizers preserve P and tangent Y=0. The normalized triangular matrix [[a,b,0],[0,1,0],[u,v,w]] must satisfy a^(s+1)=lambda=w=w^s, u=-a*b^s and b^(s+1)+eta+Tr(v)=lambda*eta. Because eta is outside F_s, lambda=1. The norm-one and trace equations count (s+1)*s^2*s=s^3(s+1). Matrix multiplication verifies the Heisenberg multiplication, center of size s, semidirect norm-one action, and Q8 at s=2. Geometric integrality justifies proportional forms of equal degree. This is a universal coefficient proof; finite fields are corroboration only.
